name: Deny
description: Denies all access to an . This will OVERRIDE any other permissions. Deny is the most powerful permission and is scopeless. A deny anywhere in a scope setting overrides all other permissions for that object in EVERY scope.

name: Change Organization
description: User can switch their organization to another allowed organization

name: Log Out
description: User has logged out (this ONLY should apply to audit logs. Never to permissions)
